comparators: Same discovered programs and same resource ceilings: static interned program/binding table. Strong exact codec targets are independent grading. Charge discovery to both arms, measure actual extra mutation/retention/migration work.
environment: four immutable V5 exact codecs; fixed 11 typed arithmetic/address operators, maximum three hops; no new tools or model calls
fixed_proposal_schedule: three min3 clones for remaining domains
limits_on_claims: This is finite program reuse/composition, not neuron parameter training or type invention
No production/kernel authority or live agentd integration
Dates are new task-instance evaluation, not unknown numeric facts: all codecs already contain their values
Static table can match or beat adaptive structure; report that outcome
This cannot qualify the failed natural-language entry or establish general intelligence
natural_language_entry: unqualified; bypassed by explicit oracle task IDs; no new held data read
persistence: Persist every proposed state, evaluation, accept/reject reason, predecessor/state digest, accepted checkpoint and migration bytes. Reload final state and evaluate fixed final dates only after candidate selection.
program_discovery: Enumerate all bounded typed paths ending in a number. Choose by exact value and ordered support on discovery dates, then fewer hop calls, then path IDs. Never feed target path labels to discovery.
revision: First attempt retained at evidence/oracle-adaptive: 2025-02 unemployment unavailable. 2024-11 chosen using only archive availability masks; candidate discovery/selection/utility unchanged. Static comparator is independently constructed from the same old and discovered programs, not copied from adaptive final state.
utility: 0.5 * old exact fraction + 0.5 * new exact fraction - 1e-6 * state metadata bytes - 1e-7 * candidate evaluation primitive calls. Strictly improve utility and never reduce old retention. Budget violations reject before execution.
